title: REPORT: Ross Matiscik Signs 2-Year Extension With the Jaguars

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: REPORT: Ross Matiscik Signs 2-Year Extension With the Jaguars
sources.description: He doesn't always get the headlines, but Ross Matiscik just got the bag. The Jaguars reportedly lock up their All-Pro long snapper on a two-year extension.
